description: If a finite subset of a partial order has exactly one maximal element, that element is greatest.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.finite_unique_maximal_isGreatest.{u} {α : Type u} [PartialOrder α] {s : Set α} (hs : s.Finite)
  {m : α} (hm : Maximal (fun x => x ∈ s) m) (hu : ∀ (x : α), Maximal (fun x => x ∈ s) x → x = m) : IsGreatest s m
